dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Lucky Charm is risk due to behavior concerns. During his time in the care center, he has been noted to intensely kennel fight and thrash on leash. He has been observed to pull heavily towards other dogs in the kennel with a tense body and has to be muscled away from them. In one instance, Lucky Charm exuberantly jumped on the handler repeatedly during the elevator ride. He is noted to be a snuggler by volunteers who knows sit and takes treats gently. Medically, Lucky Charm is healthy.

Lucky Charm came into ACC as a stray. Because of this, we do not know how he is in a home environment. During his time in the care center, he has been noted to intensely kennel fight and thrash on leash. He has been observed to pull heavily towards other dogs in the kennel with a tense body and has to be muscled away from them. He is noted to be a snuggler by volunteers who knows sit and takes treats gently. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
